releases.notes:
## Initial release

Items added:

- Redstone Sword
- Redstone Axe
- Redstone Pickaxe
- Redstone Shovel
- Redstone Hoe
- Redstone Core

### Recipes

All tools are crafted by combining any iron tool with a redstone core
